body: Orchestrator review of PR 320 final head d6343494 (independent read of git diff b896d9bc..d6343494): remote.yaml gives public-bootstrap and private-bootstrap a full-history checkout, an in-job fail-closed decide step (set -euo pipefail; full fetch of the base; three-dot diff with --no-renames and core.quotePath=false; an empty diff runs the bootstrap), a notice step when skipped and the should_run gate on every heavy step; test.yaml drops the changes job and the needs, moves the decision into the test job and gates every heavy step on steps.decide; the private-bootstrap actor/secret conditions are kept and ANDed with the gate. tests/unit/test_workflow_orchestration_skip.py (309 lines) pins REQUIRED_CONTEXTS, no job-level if or needs on any required job, no changes job, decide after checkout with fetch-depth 0 and persist-credentials false, no continue-on-error or if on decide, identical decide scripts in both bootstrap jobs, main-tests when present, every non-PR event bootstraps, the PR classification cases (mixed, .orchestration-only, rename, delete, non-ASCII), and a base that moved after checkout. INV-2 caps hold (3 files outside .orchestration). The required contexts are unchanged (7); the changes context disappears, so the check count is 13. Approved.

Checked: on pull_request github.sha is the merge commit, so origin/<base>...<sha> has the base tip as merge-base and lists only the PR's paths; a diff failure (no merge-base) fails the decide step and therefore the required context (fail-closed), which is the behaviour the threat table's fourth row names.

Checked: the pre-existing fail-open needs: changes on the test job is gone; the decision now fails the test context itself when git fetch or the diff fails. The decide step runs on every leg including macOS (bash 3.2 compatible per the worker's validation).

Orchestrator review of the revise round 1 delta d6343494..dc4e6c37 (one commit): test.yaml's unit-test decision diff now runs with --no-renames (a file moved from home/ into .orchestration/ runs the tests); the hand-written workflow reader strips quotes from keys and job names (block-style mappings only, stated as a shortcut in the docstring); tests test_the_unit_test_decision_ignores_renames (DecisionTest) and test_structural_tests_see_quoted_keys (RequiredContextsTest) added, 4 removal proofs including the audit's quoted job-level if and quoted continue-on-error mutations; revise.yaml records previous_head and the two checks. No other change. Approved.

Orchestrator review of the a02 successor heads: fca44b4c (the fail-closed reader a35a751e, ValueError on any job name, job key or step key inside jobs: not in the plain form, including spaced colons, escapes, flow mappings, merge keys and two positional-hiding forms; test_the_reader_fails_closed_on_unsupported_key_forms replaces the quoted-key test; 13 of 13 in the module, CI 13 of 13), a8c2bed9 (the INV-2 re-dispatch: task.md re-copied byte-identical to 4de54fde, no content change) and 3bafe4f2 (gh pr update-branch onto main 3c845c55: git diff 3c845c55..3bafe4f2 outside .orchestration is byte-identical to git diff b896d9bc..a8c2bed9 outside .orchestration, the PR's three files, 500 insertions and 71 deletions). Approved for the final audit on 3bafe4f2.
